parameters.query:
-- CLAIM the key BEFORE doing any work.
-- ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes this atomic: two concurrent executions
-- race here, exactly one wins, and the loser gets zero rows back.
-- Claiming first (not last) is what makes a mid-pipeline crash safe to retry.
INSERT INTO lead_claims (dedupe_key, claimed_at, status)
VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupe_key }}', now(), 'processing')
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING dedupe_key;

-- Quarantine, do not discard. A human can replay these once the prompt
-- is fixed, and the raw answer is kept for exactly that purpose.
UPDATE lead_claims
   SET status = 'quarantined',
       failure_reason = '{{ $json.invalid_reason }}',
       llm_raw = $1
 WHERE dedupe_key = '{{ $json.dedupe_key }}';

-- The CRM refused. Release the claim so a later retry can pick this up
-- again, instead of leaving a lead stuck in 'processing' forever.
UPDATE lead_claims
   SET status = 'crm_failed',
       failure_reason = 'CRM HTTP {{ $json.statusCode }}'
 WHERE dedupe_key = '{{ $json.dedupe_key }}';

-- Second write. If THIS fails after the CRM already succeeded, we are in
-- the classic partial-failure state: the CRM has a record, our database
-- does not. See the compensation branch below.
INSERT INTO leads (dedupe_key, email, company, contact_name, intent, score, crm_id, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupe_key }}', $1, $2, $3, $4, {{ $json.extraction.score }}, $5, now())
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score;

-- Outbox row. A separate retry workflow drains this table, so the lead is
-- never lost and the CRM record is never silently orphaned.
INSERT INTO retry_outbox (dedupe_key, payload, reason, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupe_key }}', $1, 'local write failed after CRM success', now());

-- Two things at once, on purpose:
-- 1) the claim moves to 'done';
-- 2) the heartbeat is stamped. The watchdog workflow reads ONLY this table,
--    which is why it can notice silence even when n8n itself logs nothing.
WITH c AS (
  UPDATE lead_claims SET status = 'done', completed_at = now()
   WHERE dedupe_key = '{{ $json.dedupe_key }}'
)
INSERT INTO pipeline_heartbeat (name, last_success)
VALUES ('lead_intake', now())
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET last_success = EXCLUDED.last_success;
